text.en:
In the construction of all Acts which have been or shall be enacted by the United States Philippine
Commission, the English text shall govern, except that in obvious cases of ambiguity, omission, or mistake,
the Spanish text may be consulted to explain the English text.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, December 21, 1900.
